title: Come Together, Right Now: An Empirical Study of Collaborations in the Music Industry
eligible_reason: Event-aligned matched-pair DiD with a single common onset in the regression's time index, not a staggered TWFE. Each collaboration song (collab = 1) is matched (MatchIt nearest neighbour, exact on release date, label and year variables) to a solo song by a comparable artist released in the same week; every artist-song is observed for relative weeks 1-60 and t = 1 for weeks 9-60 for every unit (crosstab of time x t in main_analysis_anonymised.dta: t = 0 exactly for time 1-8, t = 1 for time 9-60, 4,232 artist-songs in 2,116 pairs). The regression reg y t collab did quartile i.pair i.yr nrel1-nrel60 has pair FE and calendar-year FE but no unit-by-calendar-time structure: did = t x collab switches on at the same relative week for all treated units, so there is one adoption cohort; pairing on release date makes it a pair-stacked design (same treatment as mnsc.2022.03266 and mnsc.2023.01058). Every column also includes 60 time-varying new-release indicators (nrel1-nrel60) and Table 3 adds moderator x treatment interactions (ptc, dtc, artc, cutc). No qualifying specification.
design_notes: Stata reg with i.pair i.yr, cluster(art_song); outcomes total_plays_per_song, focal_plays_per_song, past_plays_per_song, future_plays_per_song (log adjusted radio plays). Table 2 (main): full sample, quartile 1 and quartile 4 subsamples, and a collab_number interaction column. Table 3 (main): moderators (economic, distance, artist, cultural) interacted with collab and t. Tables 9-16 (Appendix C.1) repeat by quartile; Table 23 / Figure 6 (Appendix E.2) is a relative-week event study tc1-tc60 = t_k x collab. Matching code for_matching_data_construction.R (R, MatchIt).
data_files_note: Radio-play data under NDA; the provider allowed release in anonymised form (artist identities masked, play counts kept). README says main_analysis_anonymised is the matched sample used in the manuscript; the _alternate_ files come from rerunning MatchIt with a newer version.
screener_notes: No article text. Title in package read_me: 'Come Together, Right Now? ...'. main_analysis_anonymised.dta is Stata format 110 (read with haven).
